## Checklist

- [ ] A test for the behaviour I changed (100% coverage stays)
- [ ] A line in the top section of `CHANGELOG.md`, if a user would notice
- [ ] Stateless: no module-level `let` or `var`, no caches, no `configure()`
- [ ] Results and tables stay `Object.freeze`d
- [ ] A new reference size cites its published source
- [ ] No real photos of people
- [ ] Estimates are still shown as estimates: no clinical wording, no false precision
